npc_response: The war began roughly three months ago. Reports from the northern pass confirm it — I've read the dispatches myself. The eastern flank is holding, but barely.
The southern walls concern me greatly. The last inspection revealed cracks in the foundation near the gate tower. I've submitted a repair request twice already and been ignored.
I don't discuss guild matters with strangers. That's not something I'm at liberty to share with you.
I've heard talk of fighting up north — travellers passing through have mentioned it, though the details change with every telling. I couldn't say what's true and what isn't.
The last war... I was just a girl, but I remember the soldiers coming through. The smell of smoke on the wind for weeks. My mother kept us inside. It left a mark on everyone who lived through it.
Keeping this tavern running is my life's work. I want it to be the kind of place where anyone can come for a warm meal and honest news. Good reputation is worth more than gold in this business.
I don't rightly know what you're fishing for. Can't say I've paid attention to those rumours. Got enough to worry about without chasing stories.
Aye, I was at the north pass when the fighting broke out. Forty years ago now, but I can still picture it clear as yesterday — the mud, the shouting, the way the torches looked in the fog.
There's nothing hidden around here, and I don't know what you're implying. I'm just an old man. Now leave me be.
The northern routes are disrupted — convoys are being turned back at the border crossings. I've had three shipments delayed this season alone. It's costing me dearly.
The guild and I have an understanding — they don't interfere with my operations, I don't ask too many questions about their supply chains. Profitable for both parties.
The warehouse fire last spring? A tragedy. Lost nearly a full season's inventory. The investigation found nothing conclusive — officially an accident, though I have my doubts.
I don't know what you mean. I'm a merchant, nothing more. If you're looking for something specific I suggest you try the market stalls. Now if you'll excuse me.
What Aldric keeps in those ledgers is... illuminating. Let's just say there are names in there that certain people would pay handsomely to see — or to have removed.
The market fire was a chaotic night. I lost two contacts in the confusion and had to rebuild half my network from scratch. Not something I'd like to repeat.
